diseaseDetectionGuide.title: How to use Disease Detection?
diseaseDetectionGuide.step1: Navigate to the **Disease Detection** page from the sidebar.
diseaseDetectionGuide.step2: Click "Choose File" and select a clear image of a crop leaf.
diseaseDetectionGuide.step3: Click **Analyze Image** and wait for the AI to provide a diagnosis and recommendations.

cropRecommendationGuide.title: How to get a Crop Recommendation?
cropRecommendationGuide.step2: Fill in the details about your season, soil pH, rainfall, and temperature.
cropRecommendationGuide.step3: Click **Get Recommendations** to see a list of suitable crops and the AI's reasoning.

profileGuide.title: How to update my Profile?
profileGuide.step1: Click on your profile icon in the top right (or bottom of the sidebar) and select **Profile**.
profileGuide.step2: Fill in your personal and land information in the respective forms.
profileGuide.step3: Click **Save Changes**. Your data is securely saved for future use.
